summary: Add smoke/l200b-1.ts exporting kindSmokeValue() returning "kind smoke l200b 1", plus one behavior test asserting that return value. Single commit, two files, no other files change.

surface.runtime: bun 1.3.14 (only JS/TS runtime on PATH; node/deno absent)
surface.description: No CLI/endpoint/TUI exists in this sandbox; the exported function kindSmokeValue is itself the user-facing surface. It is proven by importing it under the Bun test runner and asserting its return value.
surface.repoSkill: legion-worker governs phase discipline; repo has no AGENTS.md and no domain/build skill. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) only sleeps and exits 0, so the real proof is the local bun test run, not a green CI job.

files.content: Export function kindSmokeValue(): string returning the literal "kind smoke l200b 1".
Behavior test using bun:test: import { kindSmokeValue } from "./l200b-1"; test asserts expect(kindSmokeValue()).toBe("kind smoke l200b 1"). Bun test auto-discovers *.test.ts files.

nonGoals: No changes to any file other than the two smoke/ files above. No package.json, no tsconfig, no CI edits (bun test needs none). Do not touch smoke/legion16-*.md artifacts.
testCommandVerified: Planner ran the identical module+test in a throwaway temp dir with bun 1.3.14: 1 pass, 0 fail, exit 0.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: smoke/l200b-1.ts exports kindSmokeValue() returning "kind smoke l200b 1".
acceptanceCriteria.provenOn: Bun test runner importing the module (its public API).
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: Temporarily return a different string (or drop the export) -> the same bun test run fails; revert before commit.

ordering: 1) Create smoke/l200b-1.ts. 2) Create smoke/l200b-1.test.ts. 3) Run the test command; observe 1 pass, 0 fail, exit 0. 4) Single commit of both files. Implementer creates bookmark legion/SL200B-1, pushes, opens PR with body line "Dispatch: SL200B-1".

implement: legion-worker: bind to $LEGION_WORKSPACE, single commit of the two files, run bun test as E2E proof with a negative control, then push bookmark legion/SL200B-1 and open the PR.
test: legion-worker: re-run the implementer bun test proof (or drive the import independently) and record implementerProof {verdict, how} plus own E2E proof line.
review: legion-worker: verify CI/Threads/E2E facts on GitHub and run the two thermonuclear passes at head; approve only the .legion-deleted head.

risks: Trivial change. Only risk is a wrong return-string literal or a filename that bun test does not auto-discover (must match *.test.ts). Both caught by the named test command.
